reserves.name: Fasanara global private-credit / strategy portfolio
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Fasanara Capital receivables strategy portfolio (SME trade receivables, digital invoices, asset-based finance) held via Aureum Securitisation Fund, Compartment mGLOBAL

sources.label: Midas mGLOBAL Aave Horizon launch post (strategy and structure)

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: Midas Aave Horizon post still states mGLOBAL is a security token linked to Fasanara Capital's flagship receivables strategy (primarily short-duration trade receivables, digital invoices and asset-based finance; 60+ countries, 140+ originators, 700,000+ open positions; zero fund-level leverage; NAV-linked, not a fixed-par stablecoin). Independent rwa.xyz asset page classifies mGLOBAL as Asset-Backed Credit providing exposure to Fasanara's Global Fund / GDADF strategy with the same primary asset types and leaves Underlying Assets without a published weight table. Neither source publishes a current loan tape, obligor weights, or sector/geography split, so the reserve stays a single 100% private-credit strategy envelope with basket-needs-split. The issuer's 10% TVL Aave liquidity sleeve and monthly standard redemption are redemption-architecture disclosures, not dual-sourced live reserve-line percentages, and are not invented as a separate cash/stablecoin slice. Product page midas.app/mGLOBAL remains Cloudflare-gated to automated fetchers.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas issuer strategy disclosure plus independent rwa.xyz Asset-Backed Credit / Fasanara Global Fund envelope; no published constituent weights
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No public current loan tape, receivable-level weights, obligor/originator concentrations, warehouse facilities, or live sleeve-vs-GDADF NAV percentages. The 10% TVL instant-redemption sleeve is disclosed as liquidity design only; without dual-source measured allocation it remains inside the unresolved strategy envelope.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Issuer and independent RWA registry identify the Fasanara receivables / GDADF strategy envelope but do not publish current underlying portfolio allocation or individual obligor and counterparty exposures.

sources.label: Midas mGLOBAL Aave Horizon launch post (securitisation structure, JTC valuation, liquidity design)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 of the Midas Aave Horizon post reconfirms issuance through a dedicated compartment of a bankruptcy-remote Luxembourg Securitisation Vehicle and monthly independent valuation by JTC Luxembourg (supports segregated assets and structured bankruptcy-remoteness). It still does not name the custodian(s) safekeeping underlying receivables or cash accounts, does not publish provider shares, and discloses no rehypothecation terms; zero fund-level leverage is not a reuse prohibition. Fordefi remains a platform-level on-chain custody technology claim from Midas transparency listings rather than a mGLOBAL-specific custody document. The compartment is an exempt Luxembourg securitisation undertaking, not a prudentially supervised fund.
